comment: F4 — promo addiction. The demo brand's committed three-cycle schedule (ticks 3-5, 8-10, 12-14 at 15/15/20%) over an 18-tick run, with the hero product 3000001 the only discounted item. The mechanism under test is the learned reference price: each window teaches a lower anchor via evidence.smooth_reference_price (alpha 0.3), so the full-price shelf afterwards reads as a LOSS and decide() row 13 doubles it. Needs real purchases to measure a share, so the population is the largest in the suite and goal arrivals are left at their configured rates.
label: f4-promo
